column2: [intro]
With zucchini, peppers, and mushrooms too,
In my dancing pan, I prepare this blend so true.
Delicate vegetables, sliced just right,
Vegetarian lasagna, ready for a delightful bite.
Oh, crazy lasagna, it’s my great passion,
I cook while dancing in my kitchen with action,
Colorful veggies, a symphony of taste,
Taste buds in celebration, bellies filled with grace.
With a light béchamel, all baked to a golden hue,
A true delight in your mouth, no meat but love so true,
Guests are amazed, they ask for more,
These vegetarian lasagnas, a feast to adore.
Oh, crazy lasagna, it’s my great passion,
I cook while dancing in my kitchen with action,
Colorful veggies, a symphony of taste,
Taste buds in celebration, bellies filled with grace.
[solo]
So let’s all sing together, celebrate the lasagna,
And dance without shame, to this catchy mantra,
Vegetarian lasagna, a hymn to joy,
In our plates and hearts, where indulgence is the ploy.
[outro]
